scope: exact OS session admission and protected semantic observation refusal

commands.assertions: Fresh control-plane facts must match the requested session, UID, peer PID, active state, and lock state; changed facts are refused.
A protected session returns ErrRefused before semantic observation, while lease-scoped semantic observation retains existing safety checks.

assertions: A control request cannot address a session whose control-plane identity facts differ from the authorized session.
Protected or inaccessible semantic observation fails closed with ErrRefused and cannot report false success.
limitations: This is focused Linux contract evidence; Windows/macOS live controller acceptance remains open.
The protected-session fixture exercises the adapter refusal boundary rather than an elevated physical desktop.
